ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT(Agreement)ismade as of the 23day of September, 2024 by and between 520 Union Owner LLC, a New York limited liability corporation having an address c/o Anderson Law, 104 W 27th Street, 11th Floor, New York, NY 11221 (*Owner") and 27412 Jackson LLC having an address P.O. BOX 98, Tilson, NY 12486("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State ofNew York, generally known by the street address 520 Union Avenue, Brooklyn, NY designated as Lot 1 in Block 2741 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Owner Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, generally known by the street addresses 1 Jackson Street, designated as Lot 48 in Block 2741 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein collectively called the “Developer Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Developer Building,”"' and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the"DeveloperPremises"); WHEREAS, Owner Premises and Developer Premises were (i) formerly together a single taxlot(formerly known as Lot 1 inBlock 2741on the TaxMap)and (ii)were and continue to remain a single zoning lot, which was subdivided prior to the date herein into two tax lots; WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct one or more new buildings or enlarge the Developer Building (each, a "“New Developer Building") upon Developer Land; WHEREAS, there are certain“Floor Area Development Rights”(as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot (as defined herein) that are in excess of the “Developer Floor Area Development Rights"” (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution (the “Excess Floor Area Development Rights"); WHEREAS, the Owner and Developer desire to confirm the Floor Area Development Rights to be allocated to the Developer Premises and the Owner Premises. WHEREAS, a Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement, dated January 3, 2024,and recorded under CRFN/Document ID 2024000017802, declared that the Owner Land and Developer Land constituted a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot"); FNORIEGA/14985.0001/4343853.8

WHEREAS, all parties-in-interest, as defined in the Zoning Resolution, to the Combined Zoning Lot as shown on the Certification of Parties-in-Interest ("Certification") issued by a Title Insurance Company licensed to do business in the State of New York, and recorded simultaneouslywith the recording ofthisAgreement,have either executed theDeclaration or have waived or have previouslywaived their right to do so, and have either executed this Agreement or subordinated or previously subordinated their respective interests in the Combined Zoning Lot hereto; WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained in this Agreement and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto covenant and agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions.As used in this Agreement: A.“Additional Floor Area Development Rights"means any additional Floor Area Development Rights (other than Bonus Floor Area Development Rights) that may become available to the Combined Zoning Lot by adding Additional Parcels in accordance with this Agreement. B.“Agency" means each or any of the following entities: the New York City Department of Buildings, the New York City Planning Commission, the New York City Department of City Planning, the New York City Board of Standards and Appeals, the New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development, the New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission, any community board, any borough president, any borough board, the City Council of the City of New York, and/or any other agency or political subdivision of the City of New York, and/or any state or federal agency or political subdivision, or any'successor entity to any of the foregoing. that, pursuant to the provisions ofthe Zoning Resolution in effect as ofthe date of this Agreement, as the same may be amended hereafter, are or may become available to a zoning lot on an as-of right basis or by discretionary approval by an Agency, by (1) the provision of an amenity or public benefit, either on or off the zoning lot, or (2) a transfer from another zoning lot on an as-of-right basis, including, but not limited to, an as-of-right Inclusionary Housing Bonus, or by a discretionary approval, such as a special permit authorized under the Zoning Resolution. D.“Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks are authorized tobe closed in theState of NewYork.
